title: Asking a new data question
content: Select a report and enter a complete standalone data request. Normal chat messages are classified only as greeting, data query, or unknown; data requests are handled only by the Primary workflow.
retrieval_text:

Tags: question, new request, data query, primary

title: Selecting a report
content: Select the relevant report before asking a data, help, or metadata question. The selected report is sent to the backend as report_name and scopes report-specific processing.
retrieval_text:
Title: Selecting a report
Content: Select the relevant report before asking a data, help, or metadata question. The selected report is sent to the backend as report_name and scopes report-specific processing.
Tags: report, selection, context

title: Using input variables
content: A data request can include input variables and selected values. Send them in the variables array with source set to input so the Primary workflow can use them for FAQ matching and SQL generation.
retrieval_text:
Title: Using input variables
Content: A data request can include input variables and selected values. Send them in the variables array with source set to input so the Primary workflow can use them for FAQ matching and SQL generation.
Tags: variables, input, values

title: Using optional filters
content: Optional sidebar selections are sent in the variables array with source set to option. If no optional filter is selected, do not send that variable.
retrieval_text:
Title: Using optional filters

Tags: filter, optional, option

title: Replying to a previous result
content: To modify an earlier data result, use the Reply action on that exact assistant result. The frontend sends message_type feedback together with chat_id and reply_to_message_id. Feedback is never inferred automatically from normal text.
retrieval_text:

title: Follow-up changes
content: A feedback request is resolved against only the assistant result explicitly referenced by reply_to_message_id, then the resolved standalone request is executed again through the Primary workflow.
retrieval_text:

title: Using Metadata mode
content: Choose Metadata mode in the interface before asking what a field, column, table, report element, abbreviation, or other application metadata means. Metadata mode uses the selected report and does not run the base intent classifier.
retrieval_text:

Tags: metadata, definition, meaning

title: Finding selectable values
content: Available report/filter values are provided through the application variables/autocomplete interface rather than automatic value-lookup intent detection in chat.
retrieval_text:

title: Using Help mode
content: Choose Help mode in the interface when you want instructions about using the application. Help requests are explicit and report-scoped; the base intent classifier does not decide help automatically.
retrieval_text:

title: Unsupported contextual messages
content: A normal message such as make that top 10 or use the other buyer is not treated as feedback by itself. Use Reply on the exact previous result so the backend receives an explicit feedback request.

title: Starting a different request
content: Send a complete standalone request as a normal message. Previous conversation does not automatically change its meaning or make it a follow-up.
retrieval_text:

title: When a normal request is unknown
content: If a normal message is neither a greeting nor a complete standalone data request, the base classifier returns unknown. Select Help or Metadata mode when appropriate, or explicitly reply to a previous result for feedback.
